Two adjacent inverted blocks (aligned 1.40 and 0.78 Mb) with their order exchanged between haplotypes. Breakpoints in unitigs with 4-10 reads. Near/far mixed: 1436/348, 296/295, 399/263, 951/371 for the larger; the smaller is contradictory (792/791, 1093/979; 765/3231, 984/1945). The exact structure is not resolved.

Both haplotypes are inverted against reference chr1 15.3-17.6, so this is not haplotype-specific. The block's internal path is in the graph. Both outer ends are Hi-C-only gaps with no reads. Chain0262 at the right end contacts the right flank (10.5% against about 4%), and h2 shows a mild gradient to the right flank; the left flank is flat. Round one's suggestion that an ordering error explained this did not hold: the orientation survived correct ordering.
